'''Norman Hall''' (GEMP handle '''AggieNeH''')<ref name="retro-85495">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=85495 Registered Players - 96], 2025 Retro GEMPC, forum.starwarsccg.org (24 March 2025).
